calls.reasoning: Latest official readings: 84.5 ft on Sep 22 (ACP GatunWaterIndicators PDF), ~84.8 ft on Sep 30; ACP projection band for Oct 4-29 roughly 84.6-85.4 ft. October is a peak rain month and the 5-yr average rises Sep->Oct->Nov (85.2/85.5/86.5), and ACP on Sep 28 cited near-average precipitation when raising draft to 49 ft. Countervailing: very strong El Nino (Nino3.4 ~+3C), watershed rain ~34% below normal since May, and transits rise to 33/day from Oct 15, increasing water use. Unconditional median ~85.1 ft with ~17% chance of exceeding 85.55; low-side escape below 83.55 requires an unprecedented October decline, negligible. Could not fetch exact Oct 1-10 readings (fetch tool failure), widening spread. No prediction market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold.
calls.dossier:
- ACP GatunWaterIndicators PDF (seen via search snippet): official Gatun level 84.5 ft on Sep 22, 2026; PDF projection graph for Oct 4-29, 2026 spans roughly 84.6-85.4 ft.
- Secondary search result: ~84.8 ft on Sep 30, 2026; Sept 2026 average ~84.3 ft, Aug average ~84.2 ft; ~84.35 ft Aug 17.
- Five-year average levels cited: Sep 85.2, Oct 85.5, Nov 86.5, Dec ~87 ft (seasonal rise accelerates late Oct-Nov).
- ACP press release Sep 28, 2026 (pancanal.com; Newsroom Panama 2026-09-28): Neopanamax max draft raised to 49.0 ft immediately; daily slots to 33 effective Oct 15, 2026; cites close-to-average watershed precipitation but persistent deficit.
- Earlier 2026: draft cuts 49.5->49.0->48.5 ft (Jul-Aug); transits cut 36->34 (Sep 3) ->32 (Sep 15) (gCaptain, teleSUR).
- Panama declared El Nino drought emergency Aug 25, 2026; watershed rainfall ~34% below avg since May; Nino3.4 ~+3.0C mid-Sep 2026, NOAA CPC strong El Nino through early 2027.
- Analogs: 2023 El Nino, lake ~79-81 ft Sep-Dec with only small autumn rise; normal years rise ~1 ft+ through Oct-Nov. Feb 7, 2026 lake was 88.9 ft.
- Status quo: level ~84.8-85.0 ft early Oct with slow rise.
- Resolves off ACP evtms-rpts.pancanal.com h2o page official level for Oct 31, 2026 (or latest prior), one decimal; not off news reports.
- Event window: single reading for Oct 31, 2026; as of Oct 10 ~68% of the time from Sep 22 last confirmed reading to Oct 31 elapsed (21 days remain).
- Searched, not found: any official daily reading Oct 1-10, 2026; Oct 2026 rainfall totals; any Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold market on Gatun level (none).
